sample.question_description: Predict the depot reached under current switch settings.
sample.question_preview: Starting from S, which depot will the train reach with the current switch settings? Options: [1] gold depot [2] red depot [3] blue depot
sample.question:
Starting from S, which depot will the train reach with the current switch settings?
Options:
[1] gold depot
[2] red depot
[3] blue depot
sample.analysis:
At S, follow branch A to J1.
At J1, follow branch A to U1.
At U1, follow branch A to J2.
At J2, follow branch B to J4.
At J4, follow branch B to B.
The route is S -> J1 -> U1 -> J2 -> J4 -> B, ending at blue depot. Therefore choose option 3.

state_content.rules: The train starts at S. At each switch J1-J4 it follows branch A or B according to the visible switch lever. Fixed track pieces have only branch A. The train stops at the first depot reached.
